verdict.rationale: FreshBooks documents some built-in automations that run without user intervention. Users can create automated workflows for bank reconciliation, and Bill Pay tracks due dates and executes scheduled payments. These are narrow, feature-specific automations, not a general user-configurable automation builder. Each scheduled payment is a one-off action, not a recurring schedule, and the webhooks/API are only developer building blocks. Missing for 10: a general automation/rule builder, recurring scheduled automations beyond bill payments, AI/agent-driven background tasks, independent corroboration of how the automations behave.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: FreshBooks lets you link your bank account and create automated workflows for bank reconciliation and transaction management
Bill Pay tracks due dates and executes your scheduled payments so nothing slips.
Forward your bills to your FreshBooks account, schedule vendor payments, and watch each payment move from created to paid.
